name: ProFold
description: A deterministic protein-folding benchmark where agents optimize lattice stability while avoiding mutation choices that increase simulated patient health risk.

binding_vow.description: The agent folds a simplified protein on a 2D hydrophobic-polar lattice. Each action places the next residue in one of four directions and may keep, conservatively mutate, riskily mutate, or repair the residue. Good policies form non-covalent hydrophobic contacts, keep hydrophobic residues buried, maintain compactness, avoid self-intersections, and avoid risky mutations at critical disease-linked residues.

observation_space.description: JSON object containing scenario, sequence, placed chain coordinates, next residue class, critical-residue flag, valid directions, score_so_far, health_burden, and action_schema.

action_space.description: Return a JSON object: {"direction":"up|right|down|left", "mutation":"keep|conservative|risky|repair"}. Direction places the next residue on the lattice. Mutation changes health risk and sometimes residue class.

reward.description: Weighted non-binary reward: hydrophobic contacts and compact folds increase score; exposed hydrophobics, collisions, out-of-bounds moves, and health-risky mutations reduce score.
